intégration:commissariats.summary:
The « commissariats » feature is integrated and works in the real game on the redesigned command map. `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` is clean, and every targeted unit test and browser scenario passes.

**What I checked in the code:**
- Modules and services fit together. `src/main.ts` registers the gameplay module after patrols and the render module after renderProps. The service `police.commissariats` is published before any `init()`, so `CommandSystem.init()` sees it and installs the station UI: the return order, station cards, « Plus… › Commissariats » and the « Commissariats » map layer.
- State is reset on `session:setup` and `session:ended`. There is no Math.random or Date.now in the feature, and no TODO.

**One real regression, found and fixed.** `playtest.colonne-ia` « crs : caserne de la Cité → Place de la République » failed every time in the worktree and passed at HEAD.
- I compared against a clean `git archive HEAD` copy, file by file, and found the cause in P8's change to `parking.ts`.
- With the reserved bays left empty, the cap of parked cars refilled those places elsewhere. One of those extra cars was parked just after a turn in rue Réaumur. The column's van hit it, pushed it into the lane and stayed blocked for 4 minutes.
- Fix: a reserved bay now counts toward the parking cap as if a car were there, but no car is spawned. Parking elsewhere in Paris is now exactly the same as without the stations (0.0 % measured instead of +4.3 %), and the playtest passes again.

**Other fixes:**
- Radio and wording fixes.
- A missing held-vehicle guard in the police AI.
- Ordinal display on uppercase titles.
- A keyboard hint that was wrong for read-only roles.
- A misplaced camera in the e2e view check.
- Two existing e2e scripts that would have counted the 32 parked station vehicles.

**Browser checks:**
- `verif-commissariats.mjs`, all four parts: 39/0. Laptop 1280×800 driven by keyboard and trackpad, CRS read-only, phone 844×390 by touch, and day/night views with the per-frame cost.
- `commissariats.mjs`: harness checks pass, day and night, lantern brighter at night, phone draw calls within budget.
- `command.mjs` 367/0, `verif-ordres-carte` OK, `verif-commande-clavier` 37/0, `verif-commande-tel` 35/0, `game.mjs` 75/0.

I looked at every screenshot. The two most important plan items, « Rentrer au commissariat » and engaging a station unit, are proven headless and in the browser.

fixes: src/sim/traffic/parking.ts: reserved commissariat bays now count toward the parking cap as « ghost » occupied places (`ghosts` list, swept with the parked cars, reset in reset()/clear()), and free() is split into placeable() plus the reserved test. Before, the freed places pushed extra civilian cars into other streets (+4.3 %). That moved a parked car to just after a turn in rue Réaumur, where the CRS column hit it and stayed stuck. This broke playtest.colonne-ia « Cité → République » deterministically (player 740 m from the point; passes at HEAD). It now passes, and parking elsewhere is exactly unchanged.

tests/unit/traffic.commissariats.test.ts: updated to the intended stricter behaviour. Elsewhere must be exactly unchanged (fw === fo, ±3 %), and the city loses at most the freed bays. The old « ≤ 5 % total » rule is gone.
src/sim/police/special.ts seatFor(): skips held station vehicles (isHeldVehicle). The police AI no longer seats agents in a parked station vehicle (P2/P8 open issue).

src/gameplay/patrols/system.ts: the patrol's return message was « Retour commissariat du 9e », with no preposition. It now reads « Je rentre au commissariat du 9e, sans urgence » (also « à la préfecture… », « à la caserne… »). tests/unit/patrols.deploy.test.ts updated for the new wording.
src/ui/command/core.ts recallSquads(): the commandant's « Fin de mission, rentrez… » is now said before the unit starts its return. Before, the unit's acknowledgement came first on the radio.

src/ui/command/orders.ts: new upperTitle(), used by intents.ts (station card title) and tacticalPreview.ts (map target « ◎ … »). Ordinals stay in superscript: « COMMISSARIAT DU 9ᵉ », not « 9E ». tests/unit/ui-command.commissariats.test.ts expectation updated.

src/ui/command/tacticalKeys.ts + tacticalScreen.ts: read-only roles had the hint « ↑↓ autre action · ←→ autre endroit · U autre unité », whose keys do nothing for them (P5 open issue). They now get CARD_HINT_READONLY « C commissariats · G moi · Échap revenir ».

tests/e2e/verif-commissariats.mjs (vue): the camera stood behind the façade and showed the back of the portal. It is now placed 10 m out along the façade normal (frozen facade.heading), facing the door.

tests/e2e/game.mjs (vansBehind) and tests/e2e/verif-fin-divers.mjs (unit vehicles): both now ignore vehicles held by a commissariat. Otherwise the parked station vans elsewhere in Paris would break those checks.

- traffic.* + integration.journee* + playtest.colonne-ia + integration.colonne* + patrols* + commissariats.* + playtest.apparition-roles: 25 files pass, 2 skipped; 109 tests pass, 16 skipped. The skips are pre-existing and the test files are unchanged since HEAD (it.skip and env-gated cases).
- integration.commissariats + police-command.* + integration.suivre* + integration.engins* + law.* + crowd-radical.* + render budget: 36 files, 185/185.

openIssues: Autopilot, pre-existing and not fixed here: a column turning into a narrow one-way street (rue Réaumur 9 m, around x 2300 z -60) can clip a car parked at the curb just after the turn. It pushes the car into the lane and stays « bloque/vehicule » for minutes. The parking fix removed the trigger in the playtest, but any parked car in that spot can still cause it. This belongs to the autopilot/convoy team.

Cité bays (P1 frozen data): bays 1, 4, 5 and 7 overlap real street furniture (a candelabra 0.8–1.0 m and a Wallace fountain 1.2 m from the bay centre). Vehicles then move to spare bays or are created only when engaged. In a journée based at the Cité, PC MOBILE 1 and NEPTUNE 12 have no bay. A furniture-aware regeneration of FROZEN_LAYOUTS is the proper fix.
On the real map the 3D portal sometimes covers a real ground-floor window or shopfront (seen at the 9e and the 3e). This is P1 door data.

integration.convergence-nasse.test.ts fails at line 151 (94 > 96.5); this already fails at HEAD 2365d2b (PX check). The parking change makes parking elsewhere identical to HEAD, so it cannot be the cause.
